dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge spline with increasing curvature toward the posterior-facing apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a medium pixel radius, forming a blunt morphological peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximate 45-degree acute angle relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of horizontal base length to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, wide-radius convex arc extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak protruding from the lower melon boundary with a low length-to-width ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle visible at the point where the melon slope meets the rostrum's dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, V-shaped notch is visible on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin near the mid-point; faint linear rake marks are present on the right lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-to-light pigment transition zone (counter-shading) along the mid-body axis.
